_comment: Template for manifest.json. One entry per Minecraft version, each pointing at that version's mods.zip share link in Drive. 'essential_installer_url' is the direct CDN link to Essential's installer .exe — the wizard downloads it to the user's Downloads folder and launches it. Update the version number in the URL when Essential releases a new installer. Leave it blank to instead open essential.gg and watch Downloads for a manually-grabbed installer.
